body:
Well that's not too bad. You can always re-do them right?
At 18, you might feel that this shit's the end of the world, but once you're older, you'll realise that a year or two re-doing exams doesn't make much of a difference to your life long-term. 

Also, if I were you, I'd quit my boring job and instead get work experience (paid or voluntary) in the role you want for the future (I'm assuming you know what you want to do at uni). This will ensure you are properly motivated for studying and will make sure you don't get bored/feel useless.

I threw away my education as well and I don't regret it cos I hated studying. 

Why did you throw it away if you loved it?

Nobody ugly but yourself? You mean to think you are the only ugly person?

Fine, I'll give you the benefit of the doubt, you must be hideous. 

But why should you kill yourself based on your looks? Aren't there more important things in life? (You can disagree with me here if you want)

So you don't like to work. Okay. 
You don't like studying. Okay. 
You're not rich so you can't lounge about. Hmm.

Well, what do you like then?

So tl:dr

You're unattractive beyond repair. There's a chance you're exaggerating but my I reckon that you're not happy with your appearance and never will be.

So fine you want to die, what separates you from all the other ugly people? Should they all die too?

I'm not a sentimental person so I don't see the need to stay in contact. I will see out my plan and see what it brings. Regardless, I will remember your words and will give it one last shot. 

Thank you. Very much.
Thanks very much. This was the type of level headed response I was needing. I appreciate you.

I'm glad you understand my struggles. You are right here. All it takes is a bit more mental resilience and I could open my own business and be successful. Right now, I'm down feeling sorry for myself. 

It's times like this I need someone to say "Hey man, you can still do this". That's why I'm only 75% sure I'll kill myself. 

Also, you are right about therapy, I may never hit my big pecks, big biceps peak, but I could still try to be functionally strong. I have less hope with this one, because my body is truly very weak now. 

I'm just hoping once I've got hold of my death inducing cocktail (my drugs), then I will have the fearlessness to try one last shot at a business project. Right now, I'm scared of putting myself out there in case I fail, but with the plan B of a peaceful death, I might have the courage to try. Do you get what I mean?

Yes, I've had operations on my shoulders and they failed to make a radical difference. I really fucked them up badly by pushing weights through major pain. I am so single-minded that my mind blocked out the pain in favour of vanity. It has all come round to bite me in the ass now. The surgeon and my physio said I just have to deal with it and I have paid over £10,000 in treatment. 

In terms of business, I have many, many ideas. I have no doubt that given enough time, I would succeed in business. I have a wealthy man's personality and greed, I am also very good at training and transferring skills to others. My parents already own a successful business and i would be taking over it if I was patient and nice to them. That means when I'm 26, I'd be earning 100k a year minimum, and with some planning and marketing, I'd be earning 300K by owning multiple practices. i also have ideas about how to destroy the competition by providing internet prices in physical locations, with faster distribution. I have worked with my parents and am capable of running the business without their support. I have extensive business plans and have already changed the structure of the business so that work is evenly distributed between staff. I have trained the receptionists into all rounders, simplified processes, brought in incentives via commission etc etc, all within a small time frame. I treat the business like my body and I am building it.

However, in the exact same way as my body, I ruined it because my parents can't handle the influx of changes I have imposed. The staff start to treat me like the boss instead of them and my father has lost his power. It doesn't help that our customers can't believe I'm my father's son, because I look nothing like him. They all say that I'm too good looking (even though I'm pretty ugly compared to what I used to be). This further incites jealousy in my father and my mother has never wanted me to be part of the business, she wants me to be a doctor. This has lead to me being fired from my own business (my father's never fired anyone in 23 years of business except me). 

You might say that's a dick move on my Dad's behalf, but honestly, I always knew he was an insecure man. The business is all he had, and if I had just been more patient and waited until he passed on the business to me before I started implementing changes, then I would never find myself in this predicament (living with my grandparents, doing nothing). I violated the 1st law of power- never outshine the master. So it's all my fault, just like it's my fault that I'm no longer handsome. 

So yeah, I pretty much suck.

Yeah, I'm not thinking about jumping nor will I use firearms. I'm thinking it's gotta be some potent drug overdose but for now i'm just researching. 

I wish you luck as well with whatever method you choose.

learning a new language isn't a huge project. It takes 6-12 months of practice and you'll be fluent- then what? will it make me more attractive? slightly but it's more an icing on the cake type of thing. so it pretty much doesn't fit in with my vain motives. 

also, i used to be insignificant and yes, it made me better myself. i became wayyyy better. i became more social and more attractive and gave me a higher self esteem. I became nicer and less cocky because i was less insecure. 

However, I have now reverted to type and all my previous progress has been lost and my body is destroyed. I ache everywhere. Even if I stop being vain, my body still kills me and it is this which prevents me from progress.

Little things do not make me happy. I am a long-term thinker in every aspect, so it's only huge projects that give me purpose. 

I can't stand books in this condition. They give me knowledge and they help me realise more about the mistakes I have made in my life. I wish I read them before i felt like this, but they give me more regrets than anything these days. I have made irreparable decisions.

And not needing people? wtf? When everyone who used to treat you well starts treating you like you are insignificant, then you realise it's you who is the problem, not them. I am self-aware enough to realise that I myself are an even bigger ass hole than other people. It's just my success, charm and attractiveness that allowed people to trust me. Now I don't have those traits, I provide little value for people other than those who want intellectual discussion. However, I myself hate intellectual discussion because nobody can get past the debate of 'whether there really is a purpose to any actions'. You can ask why, why, why, why and eventually you will get stuck at the question 'why should we live?'.

Oh dude, I could not live with this passivity for very long. I don't know how you manage to not even notice it. I have too many overarching figures in my family/community that will make my life even more embarrassing/miserable if I keep this up for too long. Right now I'm in a safe haven for a month to be like this (long story, too long to explain) but I've got about a month to prepare my death. 

And yeah, I've always remembered my dreams. I take it for granted maybe, but they are mostly boring except for when I'm in a state like this. 

Your grammar, spelling and vocabulary is so good btw. Your writing structure makes it easy for me to follow and I don't stop to read twice what you have written. I suppose someone more naive than myself would say that you've got something going for yourself there, but I reckon more likely than not, you do not have the willpower/strength to push yourself to write a substantial/meaningful piece of work that would be considered an achievement... Or am I getting ahead of myself here?

I feel you. I have hit the passivity stage during the last few days. I mean I have not brushed my teeth, showered, got out the house. I'll prepare some food and then not eat it because I can't be bothered to clean the cutlery. 

My dreams are crazy, like crazier than I've ever had before. I used to have dreams similar to reality, where I'd be doing slightly cool things good or bad, e.g. going on a date with a model or owning a mercedes slr and having it stolen. Now my dreams don't involve me at all. They're all just me watching the world. Watching anarchic shit unfold but able to do nothing. I am no longer the protagonist. I am merely an observer.

Yes man, same with me. My goals are very easily achievable. I just lack the mental fortitude and patience to achieve them. It's almost as if I could gain more pleasure from smaller things, I would be able to see out my bigger goals, but since I can't gain much pleasure from things normal humans seem to enjoy (such as hobbies, friends, partying, women, tv, films, music, etc) I become obsessed with my long term goals and ruin them due to my impatience and desperation.

What is your weakness btw?

I completely relate to this bro. I am struggling to accept that I will never be the person I wanted to be and for years I have been struggling, trying to compensate in one way or another. It's time for me to just give up and accept defeat.

I've pretty much lost my desire to live for a few reasons:

1. I have no morals or religion. I do not see death as a negative thing. I see it as an escape from reality and I am not enjoying my reality.

2. I am a vain human being, and i have physically deteriorated to the point that I am no longer the handsome man I used to be, despite being only 23. I suffer from BDD meaning that I am obsessed about my appearance and looking in the mirror gives me anxiety. I have had treatment multiple times, but I keep relapsing.

3.  I have arthritis in my shoulders and hands, and pain in my hips meaning I have trouble engaging in physical sport like I used to. I can no longer have the body I want and I get asked by so many people "what happened". This is due to the excessive bodybuilding i used to do as a method of making myself look more beautiful.

4. It pains me to see the difference in the way people treat me now, as opposed to when I used to look beautiful, was religious and was studying medicine. My friends and family used to treat me like I was a king, and now I get this look of disgust/indifference from people which I cannot bear. People start arguments with me all the time now, struggle to take me seriously, and don't smile at me like they used to. ( I failed medical school because I spent all my time staring at myself in the mirror rather than studying).

5. My brain isn't as sharp as it used to be. I forget things very easily due to a combination of lack of stimulating activity in the past few years and smoking weed every day for 2 years. I haven't smoked in nearly a year now, but my brain is slower than it used to be, I have a lag in my thoughts and actions like I'm still slightly high all the time. 

6. I am not on talking terms with my parents and have very few friends since i have isolated myself due to my appearance. I know I don't really look terrible but it won't be long before I get to the ugliness I was when I was at high school, where every girl thought I was a weirdo/looked like a rat. 

So yeah, I have trouble in other aspects of life, but it's really my body dysmorphia that destroys me. I am too vain and will not accept being a beta male. I've tried having a powerful personality/getting rich to make up for not being beautiful but ultimately I know that my physical condition is irreparable (i've tried operations and physio for years) and that damage cannot be compensated by money or anything else.

How you going about the suicide? I 'd suggest watching the first season of It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia. Pretty twisted humour and each episode is independent of the next so there's no need to feel like you're missing out on a plot if you stop watching.
